objective: Qualify Kerr null-geodesic screen-to-source maps, ray-bundle Jacobi fields, caustic locations, image multiplicity, magnification, and time-delay distributions using independent formulations and external references.
claim_ceiling: This file is a frozen benchmark specification. It contains no numerical ray results, no caustic detections, no magnification measurements, no EHT fit, and no Kerr local-smoothing theorem.

references.title: Observational Signatures of Kerr Black Hole Lensing
references.role: Recent strong-field Kerr null-geodesic and spin-dependent image comparison reference
references.reference_data_status: parameter-level / paper figure transcription required; no raw data assumed

references.title: Adaptive Analytical Ray Tracing of Black Hole Photon Rings
references.role: Independent separable Kerr lensing-band, equatorial source mapping, image and visibility reference
references.version_status: exact commit must be pinned before numerical comparison

references.title: Light propagation prescriptions for black hole movies
references.role: Per-image-order Kerr time-delay distributions and fast/slow/brisk-light applicability comparison

references.title: Optical caustics of Kerr spacetime: The full structure
references.role: Higher-order Kerr caustic topology and image multiplicity reference

references.title: Efficient gravitational lens optical scalars calculation of black holes with angular momentum
references.role: Independent optical scalar / geodesic-deviation identities for Kerr

references.title: A Multi-Engine Benchmark for Relativistic Raytracing
references.role: Renderer / integrator throughput and accuracy-at-cost comparator only
references.limitation: Not a substitute for analytic geodesic, Jacobi-map or caustic validation

references.title: Local smoothing for the Euclidean wave equation
references.role: Mathematical context for Euclidean wave-packet and tube concentration
references.limitation: Euclidean local-smoothing / Kakeya results are not Kerr or Lorentzian theorems

references.title: Formal Riemannian geodesic-tube Nikodym estimates
references.limitation: Riemannian local chart results, with stated assumptions; not Lorentzian Kerr null-ray results

conventions.units: geometrized; G=c=1; M is the length/time unit
conventions.spacetime: stationary Kerr family; exterior domain for Boyer-Lindquist separated evolution
conventions.spin: a_star = a/M in [0,1); signed prograde/retrograde orientation is represented by observer-screen and orbital conventions, not an unsigned label alone
conventions.coordinates: Boyer-Lindquist (t,r,theta,phi) for separated Hamilton-Jacobi reference; a separately declared regular Kerr-Schild or ingoing chart for independent Hamiltonian integration
conventions.fourier_convention: not applicable to geometric-optics null rays; any later wave-optics comparison must declare its own convention
conventions.observer_screen: Bardeen alpha,beta screen coordinates at asymptotic observer inclination i; finite-radius observers require a separately declared orthonormal tetrad
conventions.source_endpoint: declared source worldtube or equatorial emitting surface; source intersection is an event, not merely a radius
conventions.affine_semantics: affine parameter in the Hamiltonian formulation; Mino parameter in the separated formulation; no comparison until parameterization and endpoint events are mapped consistently

screen_mapping_asymptotic_observer.note: Pin the orientation/sign convention against the AART/reference implementation before accepting an imported screen fixture.

separated_kerr_equations.turning_points: Detect and classify every radial/polar root; sign flips must be event-driven or otherwise convergence-qualified, never silently skipped.

observer_fixtures.tetrad: locally nonrotating observer tetrad; exact tetrad formula and orientation must be pinned by implementation

source_models: time-dependent compact source with declared correlation time

analytic_controls.expected: straight null lines; conserved momentum; parallel screen basis; no gravitational caustic
Circular-null-orbit radius, signed coordinate frequency and critical impact parameter match existing Symtropy analytic light-ring fixtures and an independent published reference
Separated Kerr screen maps, delays and caustic structure converge to Schwarzschild results with the declared orientation mapping
Image position and deflection converge to the appropriate weak-field expansion as impact parameter grows
Image branch count, turning-point sequence and delay ordering agree with the pinned reference cases

jacobi_map_contract.definition: D^A_B = partial y_source^A / partial theta_observer^B for a declared source endpoint screen and observer orthonormal screen basis
independent_paths: central finite-difference family of neighboring rays with independently refined angular step
jacobi_map_contract.caustic_condition: det(D)=0 in the declared screen/endpoint normalization
jacobi_map_contract.parity: sign(det(D)) away from a caustic, with branch continuity and orientation metadata
jacobi_map_contract.magnification: 1/abs(det(D)) only when screen-area normalization and source/observer endpoint surfaces are fully declared and the map is nonsingular
jacobi_map_contract.near_caustic_policy: typed IllConditioned or Unresolved; do not clamp to a falsely finite physical magnification
jacobi_map_contract.geometric_vs_wave_optics: geometric-optics divergence is not a finite wave-optics intensity prediction

time_delay_contract.requirement: Preserve per-image-branch travel time and source emission event. A variable source may not be collapsed to one emission time unless the full delay spread is demonstrated negligible relative to the declared source correlation time.
time_delay_contract.comparison: Fast-light, slow-light and brisk-light prescriptions are compared on the same Kerr geodesic delay map and source history.

prospective_acceptance.null_hamiltonian_constraint: relative residual <= 1e-12 on well-conditioned analytic fixtures; otherwise precision/conditioning aware
prospective_acceptance.conserved_quantities: relative drift <= 1e-10 on bounded non-caustic integration windows
prospective_acceptance.critical_curve: agreement with analytic / pinned reference cases under spin and inclination refinement
prospective_acceptance.jacobi_map: variational and finite-difference paths agree with error decreasing at expected convergence order
prospective_acceptance.caustic_topology: caustic locus, cusp structure, branch multiplicity and parity stable under independent ray-bundle and screen-grid refinement
prospective_acceptance.magnification: conditioning-aware agreement away from caustics; no finite-precision claim where determinant is unresolved
prospective_acceptance.time_delay: independent separated and Hamiltonian paths agree within declared integration error
prospective_acceptance.adaptive_efficiency: rays, wall time and memory only compared at matched screen-map, caustic and delay-map error
prospective_acceptance.abstention: under-resolved, out-of-chart and singular-map inputs must abstain with a typed reason

execution.evidence_contract: Reuse tools/bh-response-manifest and the existing Mycelix-DeSci ScientificEvent / Attestation pathway; this benchmark manifest is input/expectation metadata, not a new run receipt or evidence ledger.
